description: We are a team of three passionate engineers and creators — Oleksandra, Hanna, and Mariia. For this challenge, we are developing a software solution to monitor and support astronauts' health and vital signs during long-duration space missions. Our focus is on combining intuitive UI/UX design, real-time data tracking, and reliable software architecture to ensure crew safety and well-being. We are dedicated to building a functional and impactful prototype!
